name: Gauss
long_description:
Gauss is building an AI credit agent that automatically lowers the cost of consumers’ debt.

The product connects to a user’s credit profile, continuously monitors balances and available offers, and executes refinances or restructurings when it can materially improve terms.

For credit card debt, Gauss can track and automatically pay off any expensive balance on connected cards from an instantly originated line of credit, saving users thousands of dollars on interest charges and helping them pay off faster.
one_liner: AI agent that helps consumers lower the cost of debt automatically

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Alex is the co-founder and CEO of Gauss Money. Alex led credit at Nordea Bank and MDM Bank. He's a 3x founder, 2x YC. Alex has an advance degree in machine learning, was a late stage venture investor in the machine learning space, and is a huge fan of fundamental physics and artificial intelligence research.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Abdullo is the co-founder and COO of Gauss. He has a 17+ years management tenure in credit risk, compliance, operations, and technology with the largest financial institutions in Europe and the Asia Pacific (JPK, ASEAN, ANZ, Greater China).
